|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Biggs Darklighter (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploys free to Red 3, Beggar's Canyon, or same location as Hobbie or Fel. [Pilot] 2. Red 3 has an astromech aboard. Once during your control phase, may ▲Old Times.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free to Beggar’s Canyon, Red 3, or same location as Fel or Hobbie. While piloting Red 3, it has a [[Nav Computer]]. During your control phase, may take one Old Times into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' added “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”; added “Beggar’s Canyon,”; removed “Beggar's Canyon,”; “Hobbie” → “Fel”; “Fel. [Pilot] 2.” → “Hobbie. While piloting”; “3” → “3, it”; “an astromech aboard. Once during” → “a Nav Computer. During”; “▲Old Times.” → “take one Old Times into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 02. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Biggs Darklighter]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
